text: We saw a 14% dip in Tuesday's checkout completion rate. Can you help me figure out why?
[32mSure, let me start by pulling the funnel step counts for the last two Tuesdays so we can compare.[0m I'll run a query against the warehouse.

[36m$ bq query[0m
SELECT step_name, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM funnel_events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-08-11' AND '2026-08-18'
GROUP BY step_name
ORDER BY step_name;
The drop looks concentrated between checkout_start and checkout_complete. Let me check if it's isolated to one payment provider.

SELECT payment_provider, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures
FROM payment_attempts
WHERE attempt_date = '2026-08-18'
GROUP BY payment_provider
ORDER BY failures DESC;

payment_provider | attempts | failures
stripe_card | 9100 | 210
stripe_ach | 1200 | 640
paypal | 3400 | 90

[33mstripe_ach has a failure rate over 50%, way out of line with the other providers.[0m That's almost certainly a provider-side or config issue rather than genuine user drop-off. Before I conclude that though, I want to rule out that ACH volume itself just spiked, which would make the failure count look scarier than the rate actually is.
Good point, check the historical baseline for ACH failure rate.

SELECT attempt_date, payment_provider, COUNT(*) AS attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures
FROM payment_attempts
WHERE payment_provider = 'stripe_ach' AND attempt_date BETWEEN '2026-08-11' AND '2026-08-18'
GROUP BY attempt_date, payment_provider
ORDER BY attempt_date, payment_provider;

attempt_date | payment_provider | attempts | failures
2026-08-11 | stripe_ach | 1150 | 58
2026-08-12 | stripe_ach | 1180 | 61
2026-08-18 | stripe_ach | 1200 | 640

Confirmed. The baseline ACH failure rate is around 5%, and Tuesday spiked to 53%. This is a discrete regression, not a volume artifact. My hypothesis is a webhook or bank-routing config change deployed that day. I'd escalate to payments infra with this data rather than looking further at funnel UX.
Agreed, that's a strong enough signal. Let's write up the finding.

We will know this worked if stripe_ach failure rate returns below 8% within 24 hours of the infra fix landing, checked against the same query. We will know it failed if failures stay above 20% after the fix ships.
